The '''''Moonglow''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] owned and operated by [[Lorcu Malshae]] and his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Par'tha]]. The ship was destroyed over [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
